task: Pick up the spatula from the drying rack and place it on the plate.

intervals.start: The gripper has not yet grabbed the spatula, and its tip is about 3 cm away from the spatula.
intervals.end: The gripper closes and has just fully gripped the spatula, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The gripper is holding the spatula and moves it above the plate.
intervals.end: The gripper releases the spatula so that it just lands on the plate.

intervals.label: The gripper grabs the spatula from the drying rack.
The gripper places the spatula on the plate.
